## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Instagram hashtags** (5–10 per post): #handmadejewelry, #handmadeshop, #handcraftedjewelry, #jewelrymaking, #handmadewithlove, #uniqueaccessories, #accessorize, #jewelrylover, #fashionaccessories, #statementaccessories, #indiefashion, #alternativefashion, #bohofashion, #indiestyle, #fashionrebel; suggested a branded hashtag. Post counts I gave were [assumed], not checked.
- **FB ad CTR**: I computed 50/2,000 = **2.5%**, called it decent; suggested lookalike audiences, custom audiences, retargeting, better landing page.
- **Moab**: Arches (Delicate Arch 3 mi), Canyonlands, Dead Horse Point; off-road picks Hell's Revenge, Fins and Things, Moab Rim, Kane Creek; bike shops Poison Spider Bicycles, Chili Pepper, Moab Cyclery ("Moab Bike Rentals" too); beginner bike trails Bar M, Klonzo, Moab Brands. Island in the Sky: Mesa Arch (~0.5 mi loop; I said 1 mi), Grand View Point, Upheaval Dome, White Rim Overlook. White Rim Road ~100 mi, high-clearance 4x4, permit required, 2–3 days, I suggested camps Murphy Hogback and White Crack.
- **Aspen**: breakfast Aspen Coffee Co., Peach's Corner Cafe, Spring Cafe; lunch CP Burger, Meat & Cheese, Aspen Brewing Co., Ajax Tavern; drives Independence Pass, Castle Creek Rd, Maroon Creek Rd; shopping Galena St, Cooper Ave, Hyman Ave, Aspen Art Museum, Explore Booksellers; reserve the Maroon Bells shuttle. I said bear spray is "not typically necessary" (questionable, see §9).
- **Boots**: listed Merrell Moab 2 Mid WP, Salomon Quest 4D 3 GTX, Keen Targhee II Mid WP, La Sportiva Raptor GTX, Hoka Speedgoat Mid 2 GTX. User favours **Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof**; I endorsed it for rocky terrain and the NZ trek (break in first, trekking poles, gaiters).
- **Stove**: MSR PocketRocket 2, Jetboil Flash, Snow Peak LiteMax, Coleman Classic; pots MSR Titan / Snow Peak Titanium.
- **Water**: Sawyer Mini (2 oz) endorsed for the 10-day trek; also listed MSR TrailShot, LifeStraw, Potable Aqua/Aquatabs, SteriPen.
- **No-bake energy bites ratio**: **2 cups rolled oats : 1/2 cup almond butter : 1/4 cup honey** (≈ 8:2:1), pinch of salt, optional chips/nuts/seeds; chill 30 min, roll ~1-inch balls → 12–15 bites; fridge 1 week / freezer 2 months. Too dry → more honey; too sticky → more oats.
- **Smoothies offered**: Banana-Avocado Boost, Berry Bliss, Mango-Peach Delight, Green Goddess. **Chosen: Banana-Avocado Boost + spinach** = 1 ripe banana, 1/2 avocado, 1/2 cup frozen pineapple, 1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk, 1 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp vanilla, **1 cup fresh spinach**, ice.
- Bible guides: creativity, getting things done (SMART goals, time blocking, Psalm 90:12, Matt 6:33…), self-esteem (self-compassion, Romans 12:2, 1 Thess 5:11/5:18…), God's will (prayer Phil 4:6-7, Psalm 119:105, John 10:27, Prov 15:22, 1 Pet 4:10; apps YouVersion, Echo, PrayerMate).

## 9 · Gotchas (errors in my own earlier answers — fix, don't repeat)
- **Sawyer Mini does NOT remove viruses** (0.1 µm filters bacteria/protozoa); I wrongly said it does. Also "100,000 gallons" is Sawyer's marketing claim. Virus risk is low in NZ backcountry but mention it if asked.
- Hell's Revenge and Moab Rim are **not beginner** off-road trails; Fins and Things is moderate. Better beginner picks: Gemini Bridges, Long Canyon, Shafer/Potash (check).
- Hypothalamus is not part of the brainstem (I said it was).
- "Maroon Bells Scenic Trail" 10 mi / 1,500 ft is shaky — the Scenic Loop is short/easy; Crater Lake ~3.6 mi RT. Black bears **are** present around Maroon Bells; carrying bear spray is reasonable.
- Several events/business names I listed (Moab WinterFest, Moab Off-Road, Coffee Lab, Aspen Kitchen, "Easy Does It" trail) are [assumed], unverified.
